title: ctenitis meridionalis
intro: Ctenitis meridionalis, commonly known as the Southern Lady Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include the ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis meridionalis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
